examples: Free body diagram of a block on an inclined plane, angle theta=30 degrees. Block on slope, coordinate axes x (along slope) and y (perpendicular). Vectors: gravity mg downward (red #ef4444), normal force N perpendicular to slope (blue #3b82f6), friction f along slope opposing motion (green #10b981). Angle theta marked with arc. Equation: F_net = mg sin(theta) - f. Textbook line drawing style. 4K.

Circuit schematic, series RLC circuit. AC voltage source on left, resistor R (zigzag), inductor L (coil), capacitor C (two parallel lines) in series, back to source. Current direction arrow labeled I. Component values: R=100 ohm, L=10mH, C=100uF. Standard ANSI symbols. Black lines on white. 4K, textbook style.

Optical ray diagram of convex lens image formation. Object (arrow) at 2F left of lens, real inverted image at 2F right of lens. Three principal rays: parallel ray through focal point, chief ray through center, focal ray parallel after lens. Lens drawn as vertical double-arrow. Focal points F and 2F marked on both sides. Optical axis horizontal dashed. 4K, physics textbook.
accuracy_tips: 物理量用斜体符号和 SI 单位；矢量箭头标方向和大小；坐标轴标注；角度标注准确；电路符号符合 IEC/ANSI 标准；光路符合几何光学定律；不虚构物理量数值；右手定则方向正确。
